entries.zh: 踩高跷；踏桥而行
entries.en: to walk on stilts (andar en cancos); to tread over a bridge/plank
entries.notes: L 'cancos' 按 zancos（高跷）读，汉字『橋』带[疑:橋/橇]，释义取两读并存。

entries.zh: 神轿；抬圣像出巡的轿子
entries.en: palanquin; processional litter for a religious image

entries.zh: 赴轿；随神轿出巡（抬轿/送轿）
entries.en: to attend/go with the image's palanquin (join the procession)
entries.notes: 汉字『赴僑』带[疑:僑/轎]，按轎义解读。

entries.zh: 轿亭；亭式小轿（抬像的亭座）
entries.en: small chair-frame / canopy seat (of a palanquin)
entries.notes: 『亭仔』指轿之亭状部分，语义依赖上下文推断。

entries.zh: 龙亭；供圣像或御物的亭式大轿
entries.en: dragon pavilion; grand ceremonial canopied litter

entries.zh: 添；加
entries.en: to add; to append

entries.zh: 再添几粒；添加少许（几颗、几枚）
entries.en: to add a few grains/pieces; add a little more

entries.zh: 应兵；（战时）应募添兵
entries.en: to join/levy soldiers; to add men to a war (answer the levy)

entries.zh: 应接；接待应答（另有增添扩充之义的配比义项）
entries.en: to respond and receive; to meet/handle (additions, augmentation)
entries.notes: 『應』字带[疑]，且 L 'añadir aumentar' 与『应接』语义不直合，取配比义并存。

entries.zh: 加；增加
entries.en: to add; to increase

entries.zh: 接；接上使成大/接续增长
entries.en: to join onto; to piece together so as to make larger

entries.zh: 接长；接续加长
entries.en: to lengthen by joining; to extend

entries.zh: 接柜尾；补足尾款/柜尾零头（交易尾数添补）
entries.en: to add the tail/balance of the account; make up the odd remainder (make-weight)
entries.notes: 'axifique' 词形不明，『柜尾』按交易尾数义推断。

entries.zh: 接着；接住、连上
entries.en: to join onto; to attach in succession; to catch hold
entries.notes: L 'çavenells' 词形难解，以汉字『接着』与对音为准。

entries.zh: 架；架设、支起
entries.en: to set up; to raise/frame
entries.notes: M 栏调号 T99 污损难辨，按纪律降 low。

entries.zh: 架添；再架、添设
entries.en: to set up and add; to add by framing
entries.notes: M 栏调号 T99 污损难辨，按纪律降 low。

entries.zh: 贴；贴补、贴上（在赌注/账面上贴加）
entries.en: to paste/attach onto; to add on top (stake or account)
entries.notes: L 'çetruca' 词形不明，核心义『贴』由汉字与对音自证。

entries.zh: 贴到几；贴补到多少（问话用语）
entries.en: to make up to how much (interrogative phrase)
entries.notes: L 'quande, preguntando' 标明问语语境，短语按问句解读。

entries.zh: 贴一半；补贴一半
entries.en: to add half; to make up one half

entries.zh: 贴利钱；补加利息
entries.en: to add interest money; to make up the interest
